source: coreai-kit lane measurements (worktree ~/code/coreai-kit-encoder-wt, branch decide-encoder), read from its scratch records and re-checked in this lane against the zoo's own references; not re-run here
records: coreai-kit lane scratchpad r2/ (parity-*.txt, bench-*.txt, load-*.txt, tokenizer-footprint-release.txt, gpu-session.log, ids-*.txt) and <work>/laya-multilingual/authored144/kit.*
catalog_id: laya-multilingual (valid once the kit pull request lands)
engine: EncoderDecider (TypedDecisions encoder backend), GraphModel over the multifunction .aimodel
gpu_conditions: machine-wide GPU lock held (scripts/with-gpu-lock.py) and no other GPU job visible when the runs started (gpu-session.log 14:33:57)

neural_engine.kit_behaviour: TypedDecisions refuses a .neuralEngine preference for an encoder bundle at load (DecisionError.unsupportedModel; coreai-kit commit c01edc8 on decide-encoder, with a test); the default is .gpu

latency.tool: decide-cli bench, wfp16, GPU, warm, 3 repeats
latency.note: shared = the state tokenized once and reused (prefill); direct = every decision tokenizes its whole row. The graph runs the whole window either way; the difference is host tokenization.

load.note: ranges over the runs in load-gpu.txt / tokenizer-footprint-release.txt; the tokenizer (256,000-entry tokenizer.json) is most of the load time

semif.temperature: the fitted calibration in metadata.json (the kit's default)
semif.official_reference: <work>/laya-multilingual/authored144/laya-multilingual.s{256,512}.cal.jsonl (the publisher's laya.load(...).predict with the calibration set as agent.temperature)
